# SEO meta tags (community)

Authors set a search description, a share image and *hide from search engines* per page. These are declared page metadata fields with a form (`entities.yaml` `metadata.page.form`), shown in the page settings dialog under the plugin's title. `render.before.head` adds the canonical link, Open Graph tags, the description and robots.

- Saving trims the description and notes when it is outside 50 to 160 characters.
- A share image must be a path under `files/` or an https URL.

<!-- implements:start (generated by scripts/plugin-docs.mjs from plugin.yaml and the docblocks in the code; do not edit by hand) -->
## What it implements

| Kind | Name | Runs when | What this plugin does |
|---|---|---|---|
| hook | `page.before.save` | page content or metadata is about to be written (editor save, CLI, import) | Tidies the page's search description (collapsing whitespace, with a notice outside 50 to 160 characters) and refuses a share image that is not under files/ or an https URL. |
| hook | `render.before.head` | the head is about to be assembled | Adds the canonical link, Open Graph tags, description and robots meta for the page to the document head, so shared links and search results show the right title, text and image. |

Each code row matches a docblock (`Implements hook ...`, `Implements operation ...`) directly above the implementation in `src/nodejs` and `src/php`.
